name: Klaus Richter
bio:
Klaus Richter’s journey into motorsport security began unexpectedly. A former Bundeswehr Feldjäger (military police), Klaus transitioned to private security after his service. His discipline and keen eye for detail caught the attention of ProSport Racing's head of logistics during a support race event. Impressed by Klaus's ability to maintain order and anticipate potential risks, the team offered him a position, recognizing the crucial role of proactive security in a high-stakes environment.

Klaus approaches his role with unwavering seriousness. He believes in thorough preparation and clear communication, ensuring every team member understands security protocols. His background in military police instilled in him a deep respect for procedure and a commitment to preventing security breaches before they occur. What sets Klaus apart is his methodical approach, blending military precision with a pragmatic understanding of the unique challenges within motorsport.

physical.description: Klaus is a tall, solidly built man with a stern gaze.

quirks: Always polishes his boots before a race.
Insists on referring to team members by their designated code names.
Drinks black coffee, precisely at 0800, 1200, and 1600 hours.
